verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's Computer docs say the AI can split work across parallel sub-agents with the delegate_task tool, and each sub-agent is a full chat with tool access. A separate use case runs parallel agents on git worktrees (one agent per workspace) supervised from one browser tab, so the core of splitting and parallelizing real work is documented first-party. missing for 10: an agent-to-agent protocol or swarm-style peer coordination, documentation of how sub-agent results are aggregated or coordinated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can work together — subagents, swarms, or an agent-to-agent protocol that splits and parallelizes real work

citations.quote: The AI can delegate work to parallel sub-agents with the delegate_task tool. Each sub-agent is a full chat with tool access
one worktree per task, one workspace per worktree, one agent per workspace, all supervised from a single browser tab.
